name: Embercraft
description: A one-page specialty coffee roaster template with a photography-heavy dawn hero, editorial story with freshness promise, cafe-grade bean cards (origin, process, roast level, tasting-note chips, prices, roast-week badge), a dark subscription band with cadence options and an honest email CTA, opening hours, and a contact footer. Ships responsive at 375/768/1440 with warm-editorial generated art direction.
longDescription: Embercraft targets independent craft businesses that want one decisive page instead of a multi-page site. The hero uses a generated dawn-roastery photograph under a paper scrim; the story section pairs editorial copy with a stat strip; bean cards carry cafe-grade data — origin, process, roast level, tasting-note chips, prices and a roast-week badge — over generated bag photography; a dark band presents subscription cadences with an honest email-start flow; hours and contact close the page. Typography pairs Fraunces with Inter on a Kenya-Hara-anchored whitespace rhythm; the signature 'ember line' recurs throughout.

designDNA.presetAnchor: 18 Kenya Hara (emptiness school) with Swiss grid discipline

bestFor: coffee shops, roasters, and craft-food one-pagers that lead with warm photography
local business landing pages needing hours + contact without checkout
avoidIf: multi-page navigation or blog content required
e-commerce checkout must live on the same page

changelog.notes: Benchmark-driven refinements: cafe-grade product cards with bag photography, subscription cadence band with honest email CTA, freshness storytelling, eyebrow micro-labels, visit/transit detail.
Initial release after QA + uniqueness gates; first template published through the studio gauntlet.
